svg.text: Every Missing Conjunct Lets Impostor Values Leak Into the Type
A candidate value g for Gcd(12, 8) is a type error (dark red) whenever it lands outside at least one conjunct boundary
Weak Spec: { g ∈ ℕ | g ∣ 12 ∧ g ∣ 8 }
TYPE ERROR: Fails P₃: d = 4 is common, 4 ∤ 2
Weak Spec: { g ∈ ℕ | g ∣ 8 ∧ ∀d∈Common. d ∣ g }
TYPE ERROR: Fails P₁: 8 ∤ 12 (does not divide a)
Input b = 8 satisfies P₂ ∧ P₃ and leaks in.
Weak Spec: { g ∈ ℕ | g ∣ 12 ∧ ∀d∈Common. d ∣ g }
TYPE ERROR: Fails P₂: 12 ∤ 8 (does not divide b)
Input a = 12 leaks in (no P₁∧P₂ admits 0).
Refinement Type Checker as a 3-Conjunct Gate for Gcd(12, 8): Only g = 4 Passes All Three
